messages:
Ava: Quick follow-up from today's design review on the Credentials list. Two things I want to lock down: how we handle tight widths (mobile/tablet) and the revoke/undo affordance copy + behavior.

Ben: On narrow breakpoints the action column gets noisy. Proposal: collapse labels and hide secondary meta (like created-by) at <=760px. Keep primary key name + 1 icon (reveal). Kebab can stay but should always be reachable via keyboard.

Priya: Tabbing sequence feels off in the current build. Order should be: checkbox -> name -> copy icon -> actions kebab -> more menu items. Right now the inline reveal steals focus mid-sequence. Also request to increase icon tap area to 32px min.

Lee: Accessibility notes: revoke dialog background/foreground contrast fails on the small warning text. Suggest using bolder text or darker red for the danger note. Also add an aria-describedby that points to the longer explanation so screen readers read context. For toast undo: make the undo button focusable and ensure it uses role="button" and is reachable via keyboard after the toast appears.

Omar: Dev note: collapsing metadata is easy. We should avoid putting copy secret behind the kebab because customers often copy quickly during deploys. We can show only icons + accessible labels on small screens. Undo toast for revoke: we can keep a 10s window with backend soft-delete flag to allow restoration if clicked. Might need a migration for current audit logs.

Ava: Proposed revoke toast copy: "Key revoked — Undo" with a small secondary action that reads "Undo". Also show a short inline status in the list: "Revoked (recoverable 10s)" so users scanning the table see it.

Ben: For rotate modal copy draft:
Heading: Rotate credential
Body: This will create a new secret and invalidate the current one immediately. Replace the secret in any apps that use it.
Primary CTA: Rotate
Secondary: Cancel
Optional checkbox: I will update my services

Priya: Small UI polish: add a 1px divider between row content and actions, color #E7EAEE, and increase vertical padding from 10px to 12px in dense mode. That should reduce perceived clutter.

Lee: Also recommend an offscreen heading in the revoke modal that says "Revoke API key: irreversible" and an aria-live region update after revoke: "Credential revoked. Undo available." so screen reader users get parity with sighted users.

Ava: I'll update the Figma with the dense variant + revised modals and file the two tickets: (A) dense rows + keyboard order fix, (B) revoke/rotate copy + a11y + undo behavior. @Omar can you estimate both?

Omar: Will estimate today and post numbers. ci-bot: note about linting: color-contrast rule may flag the revoke small copy now that we're changing it.

ci-bot: Linter warning: potential contrast issue detected (A11Y.CONTRAST_LOW) on revoke dialog footer.

Ava: Great, thanks everyone. I'll attach the updated comps and link the tickets once ready. :rocket:
